section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 2000 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.7.6 Although break-up of total Government and Private vehicles is not available, it is interesting to note that 96.7 percent victims of 'Truck/Lorry', 62.8 percent of 'Buses', 91.3 percent of 'Tempo/Vans', 91.6% of 'Jeeps' and cars involved in accidents, were traveling in private vehicles.
